title: Boss Challenge: The Mystery Bottles
summary: Six unlabelled bottles, limited tests. Plan like a scientist and use everything from this unit to identify them all.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: planning (Criterion B) and processing evidence (Criterion C)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: Exploring Substances: Acidic, Basic and Neutral

objectives: I can plan an efficient sequence of tests to identify unknown solutions.
I can use indicator results and other tests as evidence to justify an identification.
I can explain which tests can and cannot tell two substances apart.
misconceptions: More tests always means a better investigation.
Indicators can tell every solution apart (salt water and pure water look identical to indicators).
